title: Test harness lost focus: IDE window captured instead of game
reproduction_steps: Run the automated testing agent against the game window
Allow focus to shift to the code editor/IDE (e.g. via alt-tab or window manager event)
Agent continues sending movement key presses while capturing frames of the IDE instead of the game
suspected_cause: The screen-capture pipeline or window focus was lost, causing the harness to capture the IDE window (Antigravity/VSCode) instead of the game process for ~85 frames; this is a test infrastructure issue, not a game defect.
evidence_note: Frames 120-170 clearly show a code editor with Python source and an implementation plan document, not any game visuals. CLIP p_game is ~0, confirming non-game content.
